name: Special City Council Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this special meeting of the City Council has been
  called by the Mayor pursuant to Government Code section 54956 and will be
  held in-person for the City Council and Staff. Additionally, members of the
  public may attend to speak on the agenda item, as described below. In order
  to reduce the risk of spreading coronavirus (COVID-19) and pursuant to the
  Governor’s Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20, public observation and
  participation will be facilitated by the following means:

  Members of the public may observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s
  website at https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo.

  Members of the public may also provide public comments in-person in the
  Albert O. Little Community Center subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.

  Public  comments  may  also  be  submitted  by  email  at
  publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or by leaving a voicemail at (562) 865-6262,
  extension 200. Comments submitted before 3:00 p.m. on the date of the
  meeting will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been reached.

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL
  (to be held during Covid-19 emergency)

  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701
  (562) 865-6262

  MONDAY, OCTOBER 25, 2021
  6:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING SPEAKER CARDS AND PUBLIC COMMENTS
Under California law, public comments at special meetings are limited to subjects on the
agenda only. Public comments received prior to the commencement of the meeting will
be read at this time.

STAFF REPORTS

  1. CONSIDERATION OF REQUEST FROM RABAHA KRISHNA TEMPLE FOR A
  HIGHWAY PERMIT FOR TEMPORARY STREET CLOSURE OF A PORTION OF
   186TH STREET IN CONNECTION WITH A DIWALI EVENT TO BE HELD ON
  SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 6, 2021; AND

  CONSIDERATION AND ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 21-2854, A
  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF ARTESIA,
  CALIFORNIA, APPROVING A HIGHWAY PERMIT FOR THE TEMPORARY
  CLOSURE OF A PORTION OF 186TH STREET BETWEEN PIONEER
  BOULEVARD AND ARLINE AVENUE, PURSUANT TO VEHICLE CODE
  SECTION 21101(E) IN CONNECTION WITH THE APPROVAL OF RABAHA
  KRISHNA TEMPLE TO HOLD A DIWALI EVENT ON SATURDAY, NOVEMBER
  6, 2021, AND MAKING A DETERMINATION OF EXEMPTION UNDER CEQA.
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

  2. CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF DEDICATED LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  SHERIFF SERGEANT TO CITY OF ARTESIA IN THE AMOUNT OF $270,922,
  ANNUALLY;

  CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF USE OF AMERICAN RESCUE PLAN
  ACT FUNDS (ARPA) TO FUND DEDICATED SERGEANT AND POTENTIALLY
  MAKING CHANGES TO ARPA ALLOCATIONS; AND

  CONSIDERATION AND DIRECTION TO THE CITY MANAGER OR HIS
  DESIGNEE TO ENTER INTO AGREEMENTS AND TAKE FURTHER ACTION TO
  IMPLEMENT APPROVAL OF DEDICATED SERGEANT
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION
The City Council will recess to closed session pursuant to Government Code sections
54957 and 54957.6 to discuss the following items:

  3. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE RELEASE

  4. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT
  Title: Acting City Manager

  5. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT
  Title: Interim City Manager

  6. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Agency designated representative: Mayor
  Unrepresented employee: Acting City Manager

  7. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  Agency designated representative: Mayor
  Unrepresented employee: Interim City Manager

RECONVENE IN OPEN SESSION
 CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENT

ADJOURNMENT

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-
6262 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the
City Clerk and are available for inspection.
minutes_text:
CITY OF ARTESIA
  ALBERT O. LITTLE COMMUNITY CENTER
  18750 CLARKDALE AVENUE, ARTESIA, CA 90701

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL

  MONDAY, OCTOBER 25, 2021
  6:00 P.M.

The Special Meeting of the Artesia City Council was called to order at 6:00 p.m., on Monday,
October 25, 2021 at the Albert O. Little Community Center by Mayor Trevino.

Present:  Rene Trevino, Mayor
  Melissa Ramoso, Mayor Pro Tem
  Ali Taj, Councilmember
  Tony Lima, Councilmember
  Monica Manalo, Councilmember

Also Present:  Melissa Burke, Administrative Manager
  Hong Dao Nguyen, City Attorney
  Jamie Murguia, Interim Finance Manager
  Jennifer Alderete, Administrative Secretary

MEETING PROCEDURES

  THE ADMINISTRATIVE SECRETARY READ THE MEETING PROCEDURES AS
  FOLLOWS:

  Members of the public may attend to speak during public comment or on agenda items,
  as described below. In order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19) and pursuant to
  the Governor’s Executive Orders, Public observation and participation will be facilitated by
  the following means:

  Members of the public may observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website.
  Members of the public may view the meeting and provide public comments in-person at
  the Albert O. Little Community Center subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.

  Public comments may also be submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us or
  by leaving a voicemail at (562) 865-6262, extension 200. Comment submitted before 3:00
  p.m. on the date of the meeting will be read until the time limit of three minutes has been
  reached.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER LIMA TO APPROVE THE AGENDA

  MOTION SECONDED BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ.

  Said motion carried (5-0-0-0) in the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  Manalo, Lima, Taj, Ramoso, Trevino
  NOES:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
  ABSTAIN:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None
   ABSENT:  COUNCILMEMBERS:  None

  CITY COUNCIL ACTION: The Agenda was approved without objection 5-0-0-0.

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS

  The Administrative Secretary presented the Announcement Regarding Public Comments.

  Venkatesh Koka provided public comments and asked questions.

  Mayor Trevino answered questions.

  City Attorney answered questions.

  Venkatesh Koka provided additional comments.

  HIGHWAY PERMIT FOR THE TEMPORARY CLOSURE OF A PORTION OF 186TH

  VEHICLE CODE SECTION 21101(E) IN CONNECTION WITH THE APPROVAL OF

  6, 2021, AND MAKING A DETERMINATION OF EXEMPTION UNDER CEQA.

  Administrative Manager answered questions regarding item.

  Councilmember Lima asked questions regarding item.

  Administrative Manager answered questions regarding item.

  Councilmember Taj provide comments.

  Mayor Pro Tem Ramoso provided comments and asked questions regarding item.

  Administrative Manager answered questions regarding item.

  Mayor Pro Tem Ramoso provided additional comments.

  MOTION BY COUNCILMEMBER TAJ TO APPROVE ITEM NO.1 AND ADOPT

PUBLIC COMMENT
